_comment: Template for the SERVER-level settings file. The server reads ~/.config/claudecodeui/server.settings.json once at start-up; SERVER_SETTINGS_PATH points it at another file (the only environment entry — there are no per-key environment variables). Unknown keys, including the ones beginning with an underscore here, are ignored, and every key is optional: an omitted key keeps the shipped default.
_residentRestore: Bring the most recently active resident sessions back after a restart, instead of waiting for the next send to open one lazily. `enabled` ships true: the pass launches one provider process per session, and an operator who does not want that launch burst writes `false` to opt out. `max` is the per-pass ceiling (16 sessions). `maxAgeMs` is the activity window; its default 86400000 (24 h) is the same ceiling an idle resident host is closed at, so a session that was already dead before the restart is not brought back. A malformed value falls back to its default and is reported in the server log. The pass runs after the orphan-scope sweep, never before it.
_observation: The observation wall's block cap. At most `wallLimit` observed objects are shown; the rest are folded and the response carries `collapsedCount`. The observation layer's own 「观察层自身」 entry is not part of this cap — a quiet wall must still admit when its producers are stale or red. A malformed value (anything but a positive integer) falls back to the shipped 12 and is reported in the server log.
_initiative: How many liaison self-decisions (`kind` inference or llm) surface in the cockpit's decision-queue spot-check group, as a fraction in (0, 1]. The shipped 0.2 means one in five. Zero is refused (it would silently mean 「never spot-check anything」); a malformed value falls back to the shipped default and is reported in the server log.
_architectureRefresh: The Architecture tab's manual whole-project re-analysis. `cliPath` is the ArchGuard CLI entry (`dist/cli/index.js`); empty resolves it the way the MCP launcher does — the project's node_modules first, then each ancestor's node_modules / npm-cache/node_modules, then the plugin cache under the process home. `timeoutMs` kills the child and reports `failed` (the previous analysis stays in place). `memoryLimitMb` is the child's `MemoryMax` through `systemd-run --user --scope`; 0 disables the cap. `defect` is a criterion seam and must stay empty in a deployment: `no-coalesce` removes the multi-tab single-flight and `no-preserve` writes the live `.archguard` instead of staging-and-swapping. A malformed value falls back to its shipped default and is reported to the caller with the job's readable reason.
_counterVoice: The decision queue's 「反方」(counter-voice): one model call per pending ruling, produced from a fresh context (only the question, its options and the evidence references — never a conversation transcript), then cached per queue item. It never blocks a ruling and ships OFF. `model` empty means the reply-suggestions model; the gateway (baseUrl/protocol/timeout/key) is the reply-suggestions setting, not a second copy here. `maxPerHour` is the per-process ceiling; past it a card reads 「未生成：限额」. `apiKeyFile` optionally names a key file (a bare key or a NAME=value line) and is empty to reuse the reply-suggestions key. Every call appends one usage record to the reply-suggestions usage ledger. The output is marked `kind: llm` and carries 「仅作建议」.
_cockpit: The cockpit feature switch. `enabled` SHIPS FALSE: the cockpit is still experimental, so a release exposes neither its page nor the 「会话 / 驾驶舱」 mode switch, its project/session entry points, its dedicated HTTP routes nor its WebSocket frames. An operator opts in by writing `true` and restarting — this file is read once at boot. A malformed value falls back to the shipped `false` and is reported in the server log. `counterVoice` is read independently by its own loader; this switch gates whether the cockpit (and therefore that card) is reachable at all.
_viewEvents: The local UI view-event log the browser posts to `/api/observation/view-events`: session/tab opens, dwell and where the reader came from. `enabled` ships true; with it false the endpoint answers 204 and writes nothing. `path` is appended one JSON object per line and never leaves this machine — it is not a database table and does not sync across devices. Omit the block to keep both defaults. A malformed value falls back field by field and is reported in the server log.
_sessionDigest: The observation wall's second digest tier, which asks a model for a one-sentence conclusion, reply options and a drift note after a watched session's turn. It ships OFF. `model` is the model name (empty means the reply-suggestions model); `maxPerHour` is the per-process call ceiling; turns whose readable conclusion is shorter than `minTurnChars` are not sent; `apiKeyFile` optionally names a key file (a bare key or a NAME=value line) and is empty to reuse the reply-suggestions key. The gateway (baseUrl/protocol/timeout) is the reply-suggestions setting, not a second copy here. Every call appends one usage record (time, session, model, tokens, duration, outcome) to the reply-suggestions usage ledger. A skipped or failed call keeps the deterministic digest and says why on the object; a successful one is marked `tier: llm` and its drift note carries 「语义判断，仅作建议」.
